subject: geography
title: The United Kingdom
description: The countries, capital cities and surrounding seas of the United Kingdom, and its human and physical features such as rivers, mountains and cities.

objectives.statement: Name and locate the four countries of the United Kingdom and their capital cities.
Name and locate the seas surrounding the United Kingdom.
Identify key physical features of the UK, such as mountains, rivers and coasts.
Identify key human features of the UK, such as cities, capitals and landmarks.
